clue.text: Solid block of cars

definitions.meaning: a solid in geometry, a round prism with circular ends
each chamber in a car engine's block where a piston moves

explanation.surface: A heavy lump made of motor vehicles.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a geometric solid shape and the piston chamber that forms the engine block of a car.

clue.text: A venue for a match away from home

parts.note: a sports field is where a match is played

explanation.surface: A ground hosting a game played by the visiting side.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to go far afield is to travel a long way from home.

clue.text: One providing a deal for the better

definitions.text: One providing a deal for the better

parts.words: One providing a deal for the better
parts.note: better is read as bettor, a gambler, and the deal is of cards at a casino table

explanation.surface: Someone offering an improved bargain.
explanation.definitionFit: A casino employee deals the cards and takes the stakes from gamblers at the table.

clue.text: Account that is allowed to run on to attract interest?

definitions.text: Account that is allowed to run on to attract interest?

parts.words: Account that is allowed to run on to attract interest?
parts.note: the account is a story told in instalments to keep readers hooked, not a bank account earning interest

explanation.surface: A bank account left open so that it earns interest.
explanation.definitionFit: A story published in instalments keeps running so that readers stay interested.

clue.text: Stop and fire

definitions.meaning: to cease or desist, as in telling someone to leave off

explanation.surface: A command to halt and then shoot.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to desist and to dismiss staff from their jobs.

clue.text: Packed and ready to go off

definitions.meaning: describing a gun with a charge in it

explanation.surface: A suitcase filled and ready for departure.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both laden with goods and, of a firearm, charged and ready to fire.

clue.text: Concerning inside information going to Eastern writer

indicators.note: says the word for concerning sits within the word for information

parts.note: gen is British slang for information
re means concerning or about

explanation.surface: Insider details passing to an author from the East.
explanation.walkthrough: Graham Greene was an English novelist.
explanation.definitionFit: Graham Greene was a celebrated English novelist, an example of a writer.

clue.text: No more wine — that's the limit

parts.note: ex means former, no longer so
tent is a deep red Spanish wine

explanation.surface: A drinker told the wine has run out and that's as far as it goes.
explanation.walkthrough: TENT is an old name for a dark red Spanish wine, mostly a crossword word now.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the extent of something is its full reach or boundary.

clue.text: Sit and canoodle, form bond together

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are made to take a new form

explanation.surface: A couple sitting and cuddling, growing closer.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures a courting couple; 'form' is the anagram signal, not part of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to unite or combine into a firm, single whole.

clue.text: Nation embraces popular foreign dramatist

indicators.note: the word for nation holds the word for popular in its arms

parts.note: a race is a people or nation
in means fashionable or popular

explanation.surface: A country taking a well-liked playwright from abroad to its heart.
explanation.walkthrough: Jean Racine was a seventeenth-century French tragedian.
explanation.definitionFit: Jean Racine was a French writer of tragic plays, so a dramatist from abroad.

clue.text: They examine the pupils

parts.note: pupils are those of the eye, not schoolchildren, so these are eye specialists

explanation.surface: Teachers or inspectors testing schoolchildren.
explanation.definitionFit: Eye doctors look into the pupils of patients' eyes when examining their sight.

clue.text: Not the gardener's favourite little number

parts.note: wee is Scottish for little
D is the Roman numeral for five hundred

explanation.surface: A small figure that the gardener doesn't much like.
explanation.definitionFit: An unwanted wild plant is the bane of anyone tending a garden.

clue.text: Correction as part of learning

definitions.meaning: punishment or training that corrects behaviour
a branch of study, a field of knowledge

explanation.surface: Punishment as an element of education.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both corrective punishment and a branch of academic study.

clue.text: Well organised part of the barracks

definitions.text: Well organised part of the barracks

parts.words: Well organised part of the barracks
parts.note: well organised suggests tidy, and the part is a room in a barracks used by orderlies and for company business

explanation.surface: A tidy section of the military quarters.
explanation.definitionFit: A room in a barracks used for a company's administrative business, whose first word also means tidy.

clue.text: Passing of time in pleasing fashion

indicators.note: together with fashion, says the letters are set in a new style
to fashion is to shape, so the letters of the word are reshaped

explanation.surface: Time going by in an enjoyable way.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: time that is going by or slipping away is passing.

clue.text: The prototype of a girl in love, perhaps

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the words could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A young woman in love as the model for others.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges A GIRL IN into RIGINAL, placed after the O from 'love'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the first version from which copies are made.

clue.text: Used a club building provided by the company

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company
a shed is a simple building

explanation.surface: A firm supplying premises for a club to use.
explanation.definitionFit: To hit someone with a cosh, a short heavy bludgeon.

clue.text: A way to cook eggs — divine in cabbage

indicators.note: puts the letters for divine within the word for cabbage

parts.note: cole is an old word for cabbage, as in coleslaw
DD is Doctor of Divinity, so a divine or clergyman

explanation.surface: A recipe step for eggs involving a holy cabbage.
explanation.definitionFit: To cook eggs gently in water just below boiling point.

clue.text: To borrow money then move away is risky

parts.note: to touch someone is to ask them for a loan
and means then, in addition
go means to leave or depart

explanation.surface: Borrowing cash then fleeing is a dangerous game.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom for a situation of uncertain outcome, precarious or chancy.

clue.text: Baby lettuce gets planted

parts.note: cos is a long-leaved lettuce
set means placed in the ground, as seedlings

explanation.surface: Young lettuce goes into the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Verb sense: to baby someone is to pamper and indulge them.

clue.text: What one spends won't be in deposit

parts.note: out means not in, away from home
to lay is to put down or deposit

explanation.surface: Money that won't be held in a deposit account.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: expenditure, the money laid out on something.

clue.text: Metal press

definitions.meaning: to smooth clothes with a heated appliance

explanation.surface: A metalworking machine.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is a common metal and also means to press creases out of clothes.

clue.text: Group of men in pursuit of a mate

definitions.text: Group of men in pursuit of a mate

parts.words: Group of men in pursuit of a mate
parts.note: the men are pieces on a board and the mate is checkmate, not a partner

explanation.surface: A gang of lads out looking for a girlfriend.
explanation.definitionFit: The full collection of pieces used in a board game whose aim is checkmate.

clue.text: Organised raid in backstreet exposes Chinese criminals

indicators.note: puts the rearranged letters inside the turned abbreviation

parts.note: read cryptically as street backwards: ST, the street abbreviation, turned round

indicators.note: organised means the letters of the word raid are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A planned raid in a back alley reveals gang members from China.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Organised' rearranges RAID into RIAD, which goes 'in' TS; the one printed word 'backstreet' supplies ST read back.
explanation.definitionFit: Triads are Chinese organised crime syndicates.

clue.text: Spanish gooseberry

parts.note: a gooseberry is a third person chaperoning a couple, here one in Spain, not a fruit

explanation.surface: A fruit grown in Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: Playing gooseberry is British slang for being the unwanted third person with a couple.
explanation.definitionFit: An older woman acting as chaperone to young women in Spanish families.

clue.text: Frenchwoman forced to take in a French man

indicators.note: the word for forced takes the other letters within it

parts.note: made means compelled or forced
M is the abbreviation for Monsieur, a Frenchman

explanation.surface: A woman from France compelled to let a Frenchman in.
explanation.definitionFit: The French title for a married woman, used for a woman of France.
